displayName: Phase 2 financial callables: repeated timeouts or Firestore transport failures

conditions.displayName: More than 2 timeouts or DEADLINE_EXCEEDED / UNAVAILABLE / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED failures from one service in 15 minutes

documentation.subject: Phase 2: repeated timeouts or Firestore transport failures
documentation.content:
## What this means

One service lost more than two requests in fifteen minutes to its time limit (HTTP 504) or to a Firestore `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`, `UNAVAILABLE` or `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` error. Each such request ended with an uncertain outcome for the user (the operation is one transaction: all or nothing).

## Check, in this order

1. https://status.cloud.google.com/ for Firestore or Cloud Run in `australia-southeast1`.
2. Billing: `gcloud billing projects describe constrapp-69b5d` must show `billingEnabled: true`.
3. The service's requests (read only): latency near the time limit (variations and contract value 60 s, the others 120 s) means work too large for one call — a first baseline over a large history, a payment over 100 invoices, a 5,000-item estimate build. Note the project from the user.
4. Many concurrent requests from one `uid` (policy *request surge*): misuse or a client loop.

Do not raise a time limit, memory or instance count without approval: it is a call-options change and a redeploy. A first baseline that cannot finish inside the time limit stays refused for that project (its lease expires and the next request starts again): report it.

Never paste a log entry, an amount, a customer name or a token into a ticket or chat: give the service, the time, the project and document ids, and the code.

Runbook: `ops/monitoring/phase2/README.md`. Cutover and recovery: `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md`, section *Phase 2 — the complete cutover*.
